info.title: TrendsAGI public SDK API
info.description: Supported SDK HTTP routes. Resilience is beta. Schemas preserve legacy optional fields; opaque older request bodies are detailed in the human API reference. No internal admin routes.

trend_stability.description: Standard deviation of volume over recent snapshots. Lower is more stable.
trend_stability.title: Trend Stability

overall_trend.description: Qualitative assessment of the trend's direction (growing, declining, stable).
overall_trend.title: Overall Trend

RecommendationConfidence.description: Evidence completeness metadata, not a predicted outcome probability.
RecommendationConfidence.title: RecommendationConfidence

RecommendationDecisionBrief.description: The recommendation's evidence, timing, expected value, and next actions.
RecommendationDecisionBrief.title: RecommendationDecisionBrief

RecommendationEvidence.description: A measured or structured signal supporting a recommendation.
RecommendationEvidence.title: RecommendationEvidence
